instruction: Increase the default font size in Chrome to 20 pixels for easier reading.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Chrome default font size to 20px. Custom getter extracts default_font_size from Chrome webkit preferences. Custom metric compares the integer value. Task complexity matches original - navigate to Chrome settings and adjust a preference value.
metadata.verification: Getter reads Chrome preferences file webkit.webprefs.default_font_size field. Metric compares integer values. Default Chrome font size is 16px, task changes it to 20px.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default font size from Chrome preferences file (webkit.webprefs.default_font_size)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter - accesses expected.get('size') directly (not expected.get('rules'))
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to disk
Complete coverage: instruction requires font size = 20px, evaluator verifies font size = 20
Cross-platform support with correct file paths for Windows, macOS, and Linux
Expected value (20) semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Practical and feasible: getter can access preferences file after Chrome closes
